bestBets.overview: Sunny days, no rain forecast. Track should be perfect. Kick the seven race card off with a QTIS 3yo Maiden. No's 1,3,4,5,6,7 could be aiming for a handy trail if not the actual lead. IT'SALL ABOUT MARY should be awfully hard to beat. Was a sitting shot when resuming at the Sunshine Coast,  five wide early pressed on to be equal outside well and truly facing the breeze. Only waved the white flag late, loved her will. DO A LITTLE DANCE also boasts SE Qld and looks to be the logical danger, but with one sleep to go it looks like Billy Healey believes GIN 'N' JUICE is his better chance. Reputationsn on the line albeit hard to quantify.

raceTips.comment: IT’SALL ABOUT MARY just had one get the better of her late when resuming over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast. With the added fitness, the rise to 1200m looks suitable. BALKAN MELODY was given no peace up on speed last start over 1050m and felt the pinch late. Hard fit, the extra journey should see her enjoy a kinder run throughout and allow her to be strong late. DO A LITTLE DANCE has been placed in both career starts. Fitter for that first up run, he’ll be right in this. Nothing went right for GIN ‘N’ JUICE when resuming at Gatton. He’ll appreciate getting out onto the bigger track and I think we’ll see an improved performance from him.

bestBets.overview: 1400m C5. No's 1,5,6 likely to be foremost settling. ASK ME MATE was beaten as an odds-on fav here last start but led by panels going out in 46.62 for the 1st 800m hence had to stop. Winkers come off. Having said that the 5yo has started fav in six of most seven starts and tasted defeat each and every time. WARNA was scratched from a very suitable race here recently when a juicy $10.00, opting out for a dream a few days later in Brisbane. The market said "nah, tell 'em they are dreaming"' sp'ing the horse $51.00. Was within four lengths of the winner just the same, should again be served up overs, could do very well today. LONERGY and BOLD ARTIC in the mix.

raceTips.comment: ASK ME MATE went too hard in front last start, putting up a big margin on them midrace but he stuck on bravely to hold second. The winkers come off, and with a senior ride going back aboard, he’ll be hard to beat. PRESSZORA is a talented mare and has now won five of her nine starts. At peak fitness, she drops back in class and will take catching. BOLD ARCTIC will have taken plenty of improvement from his first up outing. He has won second up previously and he’ll appreciate the step up in journey. LONERGY strips fitter for the two runs back. Down in grade, he gets in nicely with the 2kg claim and draws to get the right run.

bestBets.overview: 1050m Maiden Hcp. No's 5,7,10,11 provide the pace. 3 with blinkers off stalks?  BRITISH NAVY looks as good a chance as any, stuck to chase latest. GRAPHIEN was all the rage on debut at Yeppoon, starting $2.60 fav. Last away, the leader was the winner so one must give this another chance.The resuming NEXT STOP JUPITER draws the worst but has decent enough form-lines via a couple of two times winners from its three appearances. The newcomer OUR GIRL SNIP won the latter of her two public trials, led throughout, time was more than four lengths slower than the other maiden heat.

raceTips.comment: NEXT STOP JUPITER resumes. She showed talent in her first campaign and looks have come back in top order having trialled impressively over 1000m here. OUR GIRL SNIP makes her debut. She veered to the outside fence in her first trial but did everything right in her latest, cruising to the line to win the heat comfortably. READY AS BAM finished off nicely to claim a narrow third last start over 860m at Gatton. The extra distance looks ideal and the inside draw is a big plus. BRITISH NAVY has been placed at his past two starts and looks nearing a win. I’m just not sure about the drop back in trip.

bestBets.overview: 1100m Open Hcp. No's 1 & 5 most likely set the pace. When you drill down to the track and/or distance and/or track/distance stats the two that make the most appeal are TRACK TALE and DON PEDRO. The latter has had a little freshen up and won 1st-up this track and trip. The taking a claim looks a shrewd move too. Can see this stalking, can see this winning. MASTER MONTARO mapped a treat and may well have given them something to catch but Ricky Vale has pulled the plug on it so all eyes on the stablemate Track Tale now!

raceTips.comment: DON PEDRO has been freshened since contesting the Rockhampton Newmarket. He’d been racing well, he’s proven over this track and trip and gets in very nicely with the 2kg claim. TRACK TALE comes off an improved performance to finish third over 1200m here. She’d racing below her best this preparation but if she can regain her old form, she’ll take beating. MASTER MONTARO has returned to the Ricky Vale stable. Also freshened since failing to figure in the Newmarket, he looks well placed dropping back in distance and he’ll find this assignment easier. RESURRECTED kicks off for the new yard. He’ll improve as he steps out over further but could run a cheeky race fresh.

bestBets.overview: 1300m BM60. Map says ignore the barrier draw - 2 leads, 8 stalks. Both couldn't wish for a better scenario. Snag is ROYAL GLADIATOR hasn't got a rider and maybe 'they' did the 'less than one minute form' aka barriers and will chicken out. And so the spoiler alert proved to be. All roads now lead to TEN CARAT LUCY. The bookies have voted her 'horse of the year' for perpetuity. KING'S DUTY, BITTER SPIRIT, and MOOCHI STARLIGHT now come right into calculations. The latter maps to stalk as things stand, could be he maps to be very hard to beat. AUTUMN GALE strips fitter, for the present time remains a market watch.

raceTips.comment: BITTER SPIRIT was strong through the line when resuming over 1200m here. He strips fitter for it and the slight step up in trip looks ideal. AUTUMN GALE finished right alongside Bitter Spirit when making his return. He has won second up previously and will be strong late. TEN CARAT LUCY is hard fit and racing well. Back in grade and in distance, she’s sure to make her presence felt. KING’S DUTY won well when resuming for the new yard and just got too far off them last time. He gets in nicely with the claim and draws to get the right run.

bestBets.overview: 1500m 0-55. No's 6 and 9 most likely to settle forward, some others position handy on occasions (3,4,8,10). Very much the take on trust class, there's only two that pique my interest. GENERAL WOLFE never wins but is hardly ever far off the mark either. Warwick Satherley will be acutely aware of this having been aboard five times for four 2nds and a 3rd. REMEMBER THE BOYS being lightly raced and already a winner here looks a hope, add to that may well get all favours in transit from Raul Silvera Olivera from that alley. Next best? SHINY LOVE and WHISKEY GLASSES could get all favours.

raceTips.comment: GENERAL WOLFFE has only won the three races but looks well placed to add a fourth to his record. He’s filled the minors in all three runs this time in and will appreciate the drop back in grade. SHINY LOVE found the 2000m a touch too far last start. Hard fit, she drops back in trip and will be strong late. REMEMBER THE BOYS got the job done over 1300m here two runs back and wasn’t far away last time off a wide run. The blinkers go back on and the low draw will see him afforded every chance. ENCOURAGED drops back in grade and gets in well with the claim.

bestBets.overview: 1100m C1. No's 1,4,5,7,9,10,11 bring pace to the race, the more of them that remain the lesser their chances of getting an even break in transit. DOUBTWILLY looks a hope especially being fitter for two from a spell, won't be easy from the alley just the same. BLUE TOES was off the scene for 90 weeks but since resuming and with Wiggins aboard is repaying his connections patience. AUGUST JOE nicely in after the claim but is five weeks between assignments so the market is worth following. BELVEDERE MISS has an alley issue. SPIRITOF THE OCEAN returns to the region for just her 2nd time - if I owned her she'd race here far more often if not all the time.  TARA I AM resumes, yes fresh, wary.

raceTips.comment: BLUE TOES just found one better when resuming here off a lengthy break and with the added fitness, he proved too good last time at Mackay. Lightly raced, he looks progressive and he’ll be in it for a long way. DIALIDAE was never on the track last time and weakened late. The drop back in trip suits and she gets in nicely with the 3kg claim. TARA I AM resumes. She’s shown talent and is proven first up. DOUBTWILLY was beaten only a neck last start over 1200m. He’s fit, the slight drop back in distance looks ideal but he will need luck from the wide gate.
